observations: Photo 0 shows an open grey chest freezer with the lid raised, revealing a metallic interior and a white plastic basket.
Brand name SKYRUN is visible on the front left and right of the freezer in photo 0 and on the front left in photo 1.
Text BD-200A appears on the cardboard box behind the freezer in photo 0, not clearly on the freezer itself.
A control knob and indicator lights are visible at the bottom right of the freezer front in both photos.
The seller describes it as 100 liters and in perfect condition.

claims.evidence: No capacity label is readable on the freezer; BD-200A appears only on the box behind it in photo 0.
Photos show a clean exterior and empty interior but cannot confirm cooling function.

risks.risk: The freezer may not cool or power on.
risks.proof: A video of the freezer running with the interior temperature dropping, or a photo showing frost inside after being powered.

risks.risk: The actual capacity may not be 100 liters.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity or model label fixed to the freezer body itself.

risks.risk: The lid gasket or seal may be worn or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lid gasket all around the opening.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer powered on and cooling
Close-up photo of the model/capacity label on the freezer body
Close-up photo of the lid gasket seal
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a SKYRUN chest freezer, but its capacity and working condition are unproven, so it can be priced at the worst case of a non-working unit pending proof.
